_comment: Local Check-SourceGeometry config, read by Check-SourceGeometry.ps1 (the byte-identical census core) - the source-geometry sibling of Tools/DocForm.config.json. Birth-time file: set sourceDirs (repo-relative source roots), sourceExtensions (the language's source extensions), and excludeDirs (path fragments to skip - a vendored third-party tree, generated output). The ceilings encode COD-5 (soft, warn) and COD-6 (the nesting hard cap, fail); keep the defaults unless the project deliberately retunes them. Materializes to <repo>/Tools/SourceGeometry.config.json.
